headline.zh: 百年泳池二楼，南法风带池景

traits.zh: 走廊位和户外座可看蓝色池水
traits.en: Pool views from corridor and outdoor seats

traits.en: Serves Japanese beef bowl, salads, sandwiches

traits.zh: 饮品含冰镇气泡水和瓶装果汁
traits.en: Offers sparkling water and bottled juice

traits.zh: 室内桌椅紧凑，有绿色大理石与木墩桌
traits.en: Compact indoor seating with marble and wood tables

linger.zh: 有餐桌餐具，可坐享池景美食
linger.en: Seated dining with tableware and views
